column1: # Written by `gen_test_models align`. Distances are mesh vertex -> reference
# surface in mm over EVERY vertex; raw = as published, fit = after the rigid fit.
# verdict (of the reference actually used): exact = max within tolerance; trim = every
# vertex beyond it misses only the reference's trim (stage 1.2 passes these too);
# tail = p95 within (a few genuinely stray vertices); partial = p50 within (most of
# the part agrees, some does not: revision drift or a heavy tail); mismatch = not the
# volume_rel = (mesh - STEP) / STEP; a mesh normally loses a little to chord error.
# stray = vertices beyond tolerance of the reference used; stray_edge = those of
# them whose closest reference point is on an edge or vertex, not inside a face;
# stray_excused = those stage 1.2 excuses (asked only where p95 is within tolerance).
